applied.quote: The account includes check-writing privileges and an optional ATM card for cash withdrawals online, by phone, or at an ATM.
applied.replacement: You can write checks, withdraw money online, by phone, or via ATM, and request an optional ATM card.
applied.why: Source states withdrawing money online or by phone, not cash withdrawals via ATM card.

applied.quote: Synchrony does not charge an ATM fee itself and refunds up to $5 in domestic ATM fees charged by other institutions per statement cycle, with unlimited refunds for depositors who hold Diamond status in its Perks Rewards Program.
applied.replacement: Synchrony does not charge an ATM fee itself and refunds domestic ATM fees charged by other institutions up to $5, with unlimited ATM fee refunds per statement cycle for depositors who hold Diamond status in its Perks Rewards Program.
applied.why: Source attributes per statement cycle to Diamond status, not the $5 refund.

applied.quote: If you prefer a pure savings vehicle without checks or an ATM card, Synchrony also offers a high-yield savings product, which we evaluate separately in our [best high-yield savings accounts roundup](/roundup/best-high-yield-savings-accounts/).
applied.replacement: Synchrony also offers a High Yield Savings account, which we evaluate separately in our [best high-yield savings accounts roundup](/roundup/best-high-yield-savings-accounts/).
applied.why: Source states an optional ATM card is available with High Yield Savings.
